selection_rule: Use replication0 in the prespecified studies and all saved forecast leads; do not search for a favorable field, model, origin, or horizon.

primary_media.run: The uncropped revised_L1000 or revised_L2000 chosen by the sealed history rule
assets: Bayesian ESN mean versus observed truth with signed forecast error

synchronized_model_comparison.still_lead_rule: Middle forecast lead by array position; no score-based frame choice.
synchronized_model_comparison.forecast_leads: Every saved forecast lead, with identical physical times and scored sites across models.
synchronized_model_comparison.scale_rule: Fixed common truth/mean scale and symmetric signed-error scale over all compared models and leads; no hidden per-frame rescaling.

qualification_policy: Preserve original qualification. A saved unqualified raw forecast is diagnostic and visibly labeled; if a requested native artifact is absent, record that unavailable case instead of selecting a replacement replication or quietly substituting a fallback.
interpretation: Illustrations are not independent replications, confirmatory evidence, or a model-ranking procedure. The separate15x15 sensor field cannot be treated as a nested version of a7x7 revised field.
qa_required: Reproduce saved RMSE and lead alignment for synchronized comparisons.
Check first, middle and last frames, labels, units, role masks, fixed color limits and codec metadata.
Record PDF page and HTML/media inspection scope actually completed.
